documents.title: Synthetic runbook: CPU saturation triage
documents.text: Local test knowledge for CPU saturation: compare utilization, request rate, and latency across the affected service and its immediate callers. Check recent deployment and worker-pool settings before escalating.

documents.title: Synthetic runbook: memory pressure triage
documents.text: Local test knowledge for memory pressure: inspect resident memory, allocation rate, garbage-collection activity, and restart history. Compare the affected service with its normal operating envelope.

documents.title: Synthetic runbook: network latency triage
documents.text: Local test knowledge for network latency: inspect request timing, retry volume, timeout counters, and dependency edges. Use traces and service logs to describe observed propagation without assigning causality.

documents.title: Synthetic runbook: elevated error-rate checklist
documents.text: Local test knowledge for elevated errors: group errors by endpoint and status, compare neighboring services, and record the observation window. This checklist is operational context, not a diagnosis.
